proof_body:
by
  intro V _ G _ s₁ s₂ t₁ t₂ δ h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  exact Rel.abs_edgeDensity_sub_edgeDensity_le_two_mul G.Adj h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (s₁ s₂ t₁ t₂ : Finset V) (δ : ℝ), s₂ ⊆ s₁ → t₂ ⊆ t₁ → 0 ≤ δ → (1 - δ) * s₁.card ≤ s₂.card → (1 - δ) * t₁.card ≤ t₂.card → |(G.edgeDensity s₂ t₂ : ℝ) - G.edgeDensity s₁ t₁| ≤ 2 * δ
